bio: Akshat Chauhan is an independent mortgage broker with Mortgage Architects (brokerage #12728) serving Airdrie, Calgary, High River and Olds in Alberta. He specialises in purchase mortgages, refinancing and renewals, and offers a free no-obligation consultation. The site stresses working for the client rather than a lender, with access to banks, credit unions, monolines and alternative lenders.
tagline: Mortgage Broker in Alberta: Solutions Built Around Your Needs
